## Data Cleaning

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
library(here)
```

```{r}
tweets <- readr::read_csv(
  here("data", "raw", "Tweet", "covidvaccine.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

cat("Tweet rows:", nrow(tweets), "\n")
print(names(tweets))

reddit_files <- list.files(
  here("data", "raw", "reddit"),
  pattern = "^vaccines_202[0-5]\\.parquet$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

reddit <- purrr::map_dfr(reddit_files, arrow::read_parquet)

cat("Reddit rows:", nrow(reddit), "\n")
cat("Combined raw rows:", nrow(reddit) + nrow(tweets), "\n")
```

```{r}
readr::problems(tweets) |> head(10)
```

```{r}
glimpse(tweets$date)
glimpse(reddit$created_utc)
```

```{r}
# Inspect the newly acquired Media Cloud news corpus
news <- arrow::read_parquet(
  here::here("data", "processed", "vaccine_news.parquet")
)

glimpse(news)
```

```{r}
# 1. Standardise Twitter
# Handle the two observed date formats explicitly
twitter_clean <- tweets |>
  mutate(
    parsed_date = dplyr::case_when(
      str_detect(date, "^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}") ~
        as.Date(substr(date, 1, 10), format = "%Y-%m-%d"),
      
      str_detect(date, "^\\d{2}-\\d{2}-\\d{4}") ~
        as.Date(substr(date, 1, 10), format = "%d-%m-%Y"),
      
      TRUE ~ as.Date(NA)
    )
  ) |>
  transmute(
    document_id = paste0("twitter_", row_number()),
    text = as.character(text),
    date = parsed_date,
    source = "Twitter",
    source_type = "tweet",
    dataset_origin = "Kaggle",
    language = NA_character_
  )

# 2. Standardise Reddit
reddit_clean <- reddit |>
  transmute(
    document_id = paste0("reddit_", id),
    text = as.character(body),
    date = as.Date(
      as.POSIXct(created_utc, origin = "1970-01-01", tz = "UTC")
    ),
    source = "Reddit",
    source_type = "reddit_comment",
    dataset_origin = "Arctic Shift",
    language = NA_character_
  )

# 3. Standardise news articles
news_clean <- news |>
  transmute(
    document_id = document_id,
    text = as.character(text),
    date = as.Date(date),
    source = "News",
    source_type = "news_article",
    dataset_origin = "Media Cloud",
    language = as.character(language)
  )

# 4. Combine and clean all three sources
vaccine_corpus <- bind_rows(
  twitter_clean,
  reddit_clean,
  news_clean
) |>
  mutate(text = str_squish(text)) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(text),
    text != "",
    !text %in% c("[deleted]", "[removed]"),
    !is.na(date),
    date >= as.Date("2020-01-01"),
    date <= as.Date("2025-12-31")
  ) |>
  distinct(source, text, date, .keep_all = TRUE)

# 5. Verify final corpus
vaccine_corpus |>
  count(source)

cat("Final documents:", nrow(vaccine_corpus), "\n")

summary(vaccine_corpus$date)
```

```{r}
tweets |>
  count(substr(date, 1, 10), sort = TRUE) |>
  head(10)

twitter_clean |>
  count(format(date, "%Y"), sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
twitter_clean |>
  summarise(
    total = n(),
    valid_dates = sum(!is.na(date)),
    missing_dates = sum(is.na(date)),
    earliest = min(date, na.rm = TRUE),
    latest = max(date, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
vaccine_corpus |> count(source)

cat("Final documents:", nrow(vaccine_corpus), "\n")

vaccine_corpus |>
  count(source, year = lubridate::year(date))
```

```{r}
arrow::write_parquet(
  vaccine_corpus,
  here::here("data", "processed", "vaccine_corpus.parquet")
)

cat("Saved", nrow(vaccine_corpus), "documents.\n")
```
